desc: Implement modular arithmetic utilities (power, inverse) and prefix sum array construction for $A_i/i$.
Read input $N, Q$, array $A$, and queries.
For each query $(u, v)$, calculate $L = \min(u, v), R = \max(u, v)$.
Compute the sum term: $(\text{prefix\_sum}[R-1] - \text{prefix\_sum}[\max(2, L)-1]) + A_R$. Handle indices carefully.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check for potential overflow issues (handled by modulo arithmetic).
Ensure input reading handles large inputs efficiently (using `sys.stdin.read`).
